from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from scipy.spatial.distance import cdist
s='CP(C)c1c(-c2cc(C(C)(C)C)cc(C(C)(C)C)c2)cccc1-c1cc(C(C)(C)C)cc(C(C)(C)C)c1'
lig=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(s))
cp=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('CC1=C(C)C(C)=C(C)[C-]1C'))
par=AllChem.ETKDGv3();par.randomSeed=96590;par.numThreads=4;par.pruneRmsThresh=.7
ids=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(lig, numConfs=45,params=par)
print('confs',len(ids),flush=True)
res=AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(lig,numThreads=4,maxIters=250)
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(cp,randomSeed=555);AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(cp,maxIters=300)
cpc=np.array(cp.GetConformer().GetPositions());cp_ring=np.array([1,2,4,6,8]);cpcent=cpc[cp_ring].mean(axis=0);cpc-=cpcent
pels=[a.GetSymbol() for a in lig.GetAtoms()];cpe=[a.GetSymbol() for a in cp.GetAtoms()]

def unit(v):return v/np.linalg.norm(v)

def coord_cp(v, theta):
 # cp ring normal from [1,2,4], placed normal v pointing toward iridium (-v) when negative
 normal=unit(np.cross(cpc[2]-cpc[1],cpc[4]-cpc[1]));base=unit(cpc[2]-cpc[1]); base2=np.cross(normal,base)
 zz=unit(v); bx=unit(np.cross(zz,[0,0,1] if abs(zz[2])<.90 else [0,1,0]));by=np.cross(zz,bx)
 return (cpc@base)[:,None]*(np.cos(theta)*bx+np.sin(theta)*by)[None,:]+(cpc@base2)[:,None]*(-np.sin(theta)*bx+np.cos(theta)*by)[None,:]+(cpc@normal)[:,None]*zz[None,:]

best=[]
for iconf,(conv,energy) in zip(ids,res):
 xyz=np.array(lig.GetConformer(iconf).GetPositions()); p=xyz[1]; ring=xyz[[23,24,25,30,31,36]];centre=(xyz[23]+xyz[24])/2
 norm=unit(np.cross(xyz[24]-xyz[23],xyz[36]-xyz[23]))
 for sign in [-1,1]:
  start=centre+sign*2.1*norm
  def irfun(x):
   d=np.linalg.norm(x-xyz,axis=1)
   val=12*(d[1]-2.31)**2+10*(d[23]-2.29)**2+10*(d[24]-2.29)**2
   val+=np.sum(6*np.maximum(2.25-d[[0,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,12,13,14,18,19,20,21,22,25,26,30,31,32,36]],0)**2)
   val+=np.sum(2*np.maximum(1.75-d[np.arange(37,88)],0)**2)
   return val
  opt=minimize(irfun,start,method='BFGS');ir=opt.x
  cdir=unit(2*ir-p-centre)
  for xflip in [0,1]:
   v=unit(cdir+(-.32 if xflip else .32)*unit(p-centre))
   for theta in np.arange(0,360,45)*np.pi/180:
    cc=coord_cp(v,theta)+ir+1.85*v
    # penalty for ligand - cp heavy atom contact and ligand H - Cp H
    all_d=cdist(xyz,cc)
    heavy=all_d[:37,:10]
    steric=np.sum(np.maximum(3.10-heavy,0)**2)*3
    steric+=np.sum(np.maximum(2.05-all_d,0)**2)*0.6
    # ignore ligand P/ Ir nearest side of Cp ligand
    score=opt.fun+steric+0.02*(energy- min(r[1] for r in res))
    best.append((score,iconf,sign,theta,xflip,ir,cc,opt.fun,steric,energy))
best.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
for s in best[:12]:print('score %.2f conf %s sign %s theta %.0f flip %s ir %.2f steric %.2f energy %.2f'%(s[0],s[1],s[2],np.rad2deg(s[3]),s[4],s[7],s[8],s[9]),flush=True)
s=best[0];xyz=np.array(lig.GetConformer(s[1]).GetPositions()); ir=s[5]; cc=s[6];print('Ir distances:',[(n,round(np.linalg.norm(ir-xyz[n]),2)) for n in [1,3,22,23,24,25,36]]);print('Ir Cp distances',[(n,round(np.linalg.norm(ir-cc[n]),2)) for n in cp_ring]);print('CP heavy minimum',cdist(xyz[:37],cc[:10]).min())
# place methane outside ligand and cp
meth=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('C'));AllChem.EmbedMolecule(meth,randomSeed=234);mc=np.array(meth.GetConformer().GetPositions());mi=xyz.mean(axis=0)-unit((ir+cc[cp_ring].mean(axis=0))/2-xyz.mean(axis=0))*7;mc=mc-mc[0]+mi
els=pels+['Ir']+cpe+[a.GetSymbol() for a in meth.GetAtoms()];coords=np.vstack([xyz,ir,cc,mc]); assert len(els)==len(coords)
with open('initial.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{len(els)}\n+1 charge doublet organoiridium methane\n');
 for el,pos in zip(els,coords):f.write('%-2s %12.7f %12.7f %12.7f\n'%(el,*pos))
np.savez('indexes.npz',cp_ring=cp_ring,Ir=len(xyz),cp_start=len(xyz)+1)
PY
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python build.py
